intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A button pops off Tavri’s cuff, bounces off your nose, and lands in your pocket.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Tavri laughs. It’s a loud, startled honk, nothing like her court laugh.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Oh no. That was awful. That was a goose.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “My reputation’s finished. Tell the chroniclers I honked.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “You sounded like you were having fun.”

options.labelText: “Keep the polished one for court. I’ll take the goose.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “You’ll get it whether you like it or not. It keeps escaping around you.”

options.labelText: “Ha! Maybe practice a quieter one for court, though?”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She demonstrates. It’s a lovely laugh, with no goose in it anywhere.
